elements.title: Russian Memorial Church in Leipzig (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Russia funded the building of the Russian Memorial Church in Leipzig (pictured) as a monument to the 22,000 Russians who died in the 1813 Battle of Leipzig against Napoleon?

elements.title: their first collaboration (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Jean-Paul Belmondo allowed Jean-Luc Godard to dub over his lines on their first collaboration, on the condition that Belmondo be cast in Godard's first feature film?

elements.title: Guantanamo Migrant Operations Center (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Yang Nien-hsi (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Balshavik (Wikipedia — did you know?)
